problem:
The quadratic Taylor approximation of the function $f(x)$ about $x=a\in {R}^{2}$ is given by

$$
f(x)≈4+\frac{1}{2}(x-a)^{T}A(x-a),
$$

where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

 

Which of the following statements are true?

- ${a}_{11}=5$ and $det(A)=2$
- $A$ is positive-definite
- $a$ is a local minimum of $f$

choices.value: None of the statements are true
